text: And when you're feeling blue, speak high from the liu. Now you, scared old, run off and paddle, paddle your own canoe. Well, Lindy's boat just took on, so he said, this is a noble blow. You'll think you've frappled on my loving heart. Miss Lindy-Loo, I'm so glad you're here.
